During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] unit [[Havoc Squad]] was dispatched to the Imperial prisoner-of-war facility [[A-77 (prison)|A-77]] in order to rescue [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ava Jaxo]] and the other prisoners there. However, the operation was actually a trap set by Havoc Squad's enemy [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]], and the squad barely escaped with the prisoners before the station's destruction.
